external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A deployed sensor node installed on a customer site.
external_entities.source_excerpt: a few thousand sensor nodes installed on customer sites
external_entities.notes: Outside our physical control; a technician can be standing next to one with a laptop. The authentication key is per fleet, not per device, and has not been rotated since deployment.

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.notes: The source does not state what authentication the console has, if any.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who views telemetry dashboards.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker that accepts sensor readings and forwards them to Pub/Sub.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE
processes.notes: Nodes authenticate with a fleet-wide pre-shared key. The gateway looks up the device in the registry and forwards accepted readings.

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer that picks up readings and writes them into the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry containing device information used to check keys and identify customer ownership.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A messaging service receiving readings from the device gateway for the telemetry normalizer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing sensor readings, site addresses, and occupancy patterns.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: Cloud Storage bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket from which sensor nodes retrieve firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. The source does not state whether nodes authenticate or whether they verify image signatures before installation.

data_flows.name: publish readings
data_flows.description: Sensor nodes publish readings to the device gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway

data_flows.name: look up device
data_flows.description: The device gateway looks up device information in the registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.

data_flows.name: forward readings
data_flows.description: The device gateway forwards accepted readings to Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: pick up readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: write readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer writes readings into the telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery

data_flows.name: poll image
data_flows.description: Sensor nodes poll the Cloud Storage bucket for firmware images.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image

data_flows.name: service node
data_flows.description: A field technician services a sensor node over its local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state what authentication the console has, if any.

data_flows.name: view dashboards
data_flows.description: Fleet operators view dashboards using BigQuery from the corporate network.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO.

assumptions.assumption: The device gateway presents a non-web interface because it is described as an MQTT broker.
assumptions.basis: The source identifies the device gateway as an MQTT broker.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry normalizer presents a non-web interface because it is described as a Python consumer rather than a web application.
assumptions.basis: The source identifies it as a Python consumer in the analytics network.

assumptions.assumption: The device registry contains confidential data because it contains keys and customer associations.
assumptions.basis: The source says the registry is used to check the key and determine which customer a node belongs to.

assumptions.assumption: Pub/Sub carries confidential data because it carries sensor readings that are customer data.
assumptions.basis: The source says accepted readings are forwarded onto Pub/Sub and identifies the readings as customer data through the lake contents.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake contains confidential data because it contains site addresses and occupancy patterns identified as customer data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns and is customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The Cloud Storage bucket contains business-critical data because it stores firmware images used by the deployed sensor fleet.
assumptions.basis: The bucket stores firmware images that sensor nodes install.
